headline: What each listed part does

parts.title: Adjustable stock
parts.detail: Changes the length of pull, so a smaller frame gets a proper fit

parts.title: Pistol grip
parts.detail: Easier to control, with a natural hand and wrist position

parts.title: Forward grip
parts.detail: Gives the support hand a place to steady the rifle

parts.title: Threaded barrel
parts.detail: Accepts a flash suppressor or muzzle brake

parts.title: Shroud
parts.detail: Shields the bearer's hand from heat

sources: Sources: G.L. c.140, s.121 (the five features)
